symptom: Engine does not crank when starting switch is turned to “START” position.
related_information: If any failure code is displayed, perform troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.point_to_check: When starting switch is turned to START position, starting motor pinion does not come out.
steps.remedy: Perform the troubleshooting for “ENGINE DOES NOT START (ENGINE DOES NOT CRANK)” in E mode, and take corrective action.

steps.point_to_check: • Starting motor pinion makes a rasping sound. (When starting switch is turned to START position, starting motor pinion comes out.) • Starting motor pinion comes off halfway. (When starting switch is turned to START position, starting motor pinion comes out.) • Starting motor makes flapping sound and does not turn. (When starting switch is turned to START position, starting motor pinion comes out.) (Reference: “Flapping sound” means sound made when starting motor pinion comes in and out.)
steps.remedy: Perform the troubleshooting for “ENGINE DOES NOT START (ENGINE DOES NOT CRANK)” in E mode, and take corrective action.

steps.point_to_check: If the starting motor pinion makes a rasping sound and the starting motor does not turn, visually check the flywheel ring gear.
steps.remedy: Replace if the item is broken
